about: rhythm: onsets in beats from the first note, start = its place in a 4/4 bar, share = how often it is played exactly so; harmony: start = the first note above the root of the chord under it, chords = [whole beats from the first note's beat, the note it arrives at, root above the first chord's root, quality], share = how often.
